review_before_publish: Default-on local preparation and plans; selected YouTube posts can be approved together after one explicit review, with an individual approval and exact-post reuse assertion where needed. No standing approval or future-post grant.
brain_guidance: Enabled saved notes and examples are matched using source and spoken context through selection, plan and render. Recognized supported preferences apply with Settings fallback and explicit clip-edit precedence. Example appearance is not automatically learned; existing rendered media is not silently rewritten.
audio_fix: First-track stereo downmix precedes processing, with compensated clip-relative timing and a final peak limiter after gain. Existing/source distortion and previously rendered/uploaded media are not repaired automatically.
youtube_comments: Strict boolean kids answers and returned current status; review explains kids/private/platform restrictions without changing audience/kids answers or promising an API comments-enable switch.
ongoing_discovery: Independent provider waits; at most 15-minute recurrence with available preparation capacity and remaining source allowance, otherwise configured cadence; bounded page rotation, quality/cost/API limits and exact waits remain.
optional_free_search: Existing sealed YouTube/Tavily keys exposed under Search connections; connected YouTube search and no-key Commons supported. Tavily free-plan preset uses 1,000 included credits and $0 paid budget; this is an app allowance, not a live provider balance.
live_capture: Compatible split HLS video/audio with shared-clock relay and bounded ended-public-archive availability recovery; private/protected/missing media remains unavailable.
windows_cleanup: Specific native WinError10054 stdlib Proactor cleanup callback handled with transport/socket detachment; unrelated failures still reported. Linux native-transport tests do not establish Windows runtime behavior.
search_connection_recovery: Saved YouTube/Tavily keys trim outer whitespace and reject accidental internal whitespace/control text. YouTube discovery refreshes a rejected same-account OAuth token once, counts every read and preserves Retry-After/quota and explicit optional-key selection. Credential-safe errors distinguish invalid/restricted keys and disabled projects; Tavily server waits remain durable and provider-local.
saved_search_tests: Explicit local-page-only uncached checks: selected YouTube credential via general-quota videos.list, Tavily via authenticated account-usage GET. No source import, web search, upload or automatic credential switch. Actual response shapes, concurrency/cooldowns, provider waits, budgets and changed-key staleness are checked. Success proves API credential access at that time, not available search allowance/media/quality or posting permission. Tavily usage endpoint has no documented express zero-credit guarantee.
discovery_diagnosis: Missions and health show provider-specific safe actions, retain independent provider/local work and avoid treating a configured but failing connection as healthy or applying YouTube reset advice to other services.
reuse_review_brain_separation: Reuse statements remain exact selected-post approval records, not Brain knowledge or future guidance. No automatic permission-to-Brain write was found; existing behavior is verified by single/bulk approval and learner projection tests and clarified in forms/saved details. Existing review records are retained.

capture_recheck.reason: Only new connection screenshot framing was changed to center each row and avoid the sticky save bar. Product code and test assertions were unchanged.

browser_verification.scope: Disposable sandbox and fake platforms. All key-tests/settings/reuse approval mutations intercepted. Eight new checks cover missing connections, explicit safe tests, saved API-key/connected-account modes, no automatic provider calls, unsaved-key disabling/save refresh, both provider rejection/correction flows, durable waits, stale earlier results and service interruption. Existing discovery masking/replacement/removal/free-only controls and previous Brain, comments, single/bulk approval coverage retained. Single and bulk review show that permission assertions remain with exact posts and are not Brain knowledge. Actual local Brain uploads/lookup/reload tests still use throwaway data. No owner data, real provider keys, external searches, account publishing or Windows/GPU was tested.
